mapper.select: SELECT s.*, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status='CONFIRMED' THEN r.guest_count ELSE 0 END),0) reserved_count FROM reservation_slot s LEFT JOIN reservation r ON r.slot_id=s.id WHERE s.reserved_date=#{date} GROUP BY s.id HAVING s.capacity > reserved_count ORDER BY s.start_time
SELECT * FROM reservation_slot WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(guest_count),0) FROM reservation WHERE slot_id=#{id} AND status='CONFIRMED'
